combination_flags.reason: If placed together on one claim for the same condition, lumbar radiculopathy is generally not reported separately with lumbar disc disorder with radiculopathy; M54.1 has Excludes1-style conflict with disc-disorder radiculopathy codes.
If combined, lumbosacral radiculopathy is generally not separately coded with lumbosacral disc disorder with radiculopathy due to an Excludes1-style conflict.

If combined for the same back-pain condition, low back pain may conflict with or be redundant to lumbar disc displacement because M54.5 has Excludes1-style guidance for lumbago due to intervertebral disc displacement.
